name: Gnocchi alla Sorrentina
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Soften crushed garlic in olive oil, then add passata, pepper and half the salt.
Simmer the tomato sauce for 12 minutes until slightly thickened, then tear in half the basil.
Boil water with remaining salt. Add gnocchi in batches and lift out when they float and are tender, following the packet timing.
Fold gnocchi into sauce, transfer to a baking dish and scatter torn mozzarella on top. Bake 10 minutes until bubbling; finish with remaining basil.
tips: Check that packaged gnocchi is egg-free and mozzarella is made with vegetarian rennet.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
